nom: LIERAC Hydragenist Lip Balm with Pink Gloss Effect, Rose Vanilla

avis.texte: Disappointed because I bought this on a recommendation from a beauty blogger. She described it as having the consistency of a lip balm with a pretty pink tint. Consistency is fine but I don’t see the tint. There is actually shimmer which I don’t enjoy. Smell is not unpleasant and I’m fact reminded me of a lip balm I used to buy from Avon years ago. I expected more from a $19 product.

I honestly don't see what the difference between this and any other cheap ph lip balm is. The glitter in it is okay, but kind of a weird feature, you can feel the grit of the glitter a bit. Save your money and buy a cheap ph balm instead. The color and feel on the lips is great but the price is terrible.

avis.titre: A buttery bliss that is bar none!
avis.texte: I was first introduced to this product when I was in Greece. I was out of my normal moisturizer so I grabbed some of this - it has been my go to ever since. Absorbs like a dream and doesn’t feel like wax as many do - can’t say enough about how amazing it is. Highly recommend!!!!!

avis.titre: Lovely texture and color. Need to reapply often.
avis.texte: Like all of their products, this one too, is high quality, smooth, soft and pretty. The one downside is that the feel doesn’t last long so I reapply a lot but it’s still worth it for me.

Gave my lips irritation. In photo of ad the product looks entirely pink, even the lip balm, and it says it should smell like vanilla and Rose. Doesn't smell like that, can't smell anything and it made my lips itchy. I can't tell if this is authentic or not. Will return when I have time to go to the post. Wish it worked because I generally enjoy this brand.

Nada más ponerlo en los labios supe que había acertado de pleno, de nuevo, con Lierac. Marca que me gusta por sus cuidados productos de muy buena calidad. Buena hidratación con un poquito de brillo y que resaltan. Recomiendo.
My sister recommended this as a present for my wife and when she received it she loved it and have bought several since they are very good quality

Esattamente ciò che cercavo, un idratante per le labbra leggermente colorato, tendente al rosa, da mettere al posto del rossetto e che funzioni. Le labbra sono decisamente più idratate e morbide, e il prezzo è ottimo. Lo consiglio.
